title: Special Executive Programme In Managerial Accounting
description: The course aims to equip learners with a solid understanding of managerial accounting concepts and their applications in financial decision-making.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme (SEP) in Managerial Accounting offers in-depth knowledge of variance analysis, cost-volume-profit (CVP) analysis, differential analysis, and budgeting. Learners will explore key topics like direct material and labor cost variance, factory overhead variances, capital investment analysis, and master budgeting techniques to drive organizational performance.
courseDetails: Understand CVP Analysis. Understand Breakeven Point. Understand the Margin of Safety. Understand Operating Leverage. Understand Sales Mix. Understand Sales Mix and Break-even Analysis. Analysis of units manufactured. Analysis of variable and absorption costing. Contribution margin analysis. Explore Different Budgets like Static Budget, Flexible Budget, Master Budget, Operating Budget etc. The course covers core aspects of managerial accounting, including variance analysis, CVP analysis, and differential analysis. Learners will dive into the complexities of budgeting, exploring static, flexible, and master budgets, and understand how different costing methods such as variable and absorption costing affect business decisions. The program also focuses on interpreting financial data to support capital investment decisions and improve operational efficiency. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Fundamentals of Managerial Accounting: Understanding Cost Volume Profit Analysis: Understanding Variable Costing AnalysisCorporate Work Environment: Understanding Master Budgeting: Understanding the Dynamics of Variance and Differential Analysis:
